text:
maria: dropping in a round of UX feedback for the routing editor. Key areas: grouping rules, unreachable rule treatment, color/contrast for priority badges, and the preview step-through mode. Screenshot: https://img.example/routing-stepper.png

julie: thanks. quick thoughts: grouping would help when teams have 30+ rules. Proposal: collapsible groups with header that shows aggregate match-rate and a small numeric badge for group priority.

tonny: typo: my name is tony :) re: grouping 3 I like it but need a clear affordance for drag-and-drop between groups. Drag handles alone are confusing in compact lists.

evan: a11y note: badges use low-contrast gray on light background currently. Failing WCAG 2.1 AA for small text. Use >4.5:1 contrast or larger bold numbers.

rachel: unreachable rules 3 current idea 'ghost' them (lower opacity). testers thought ghosting made them disappear. Better: keep them visible but add a clear banner: 'This rule is shadowed by Rule 3 (superset condition)'. Include an inline action: [Edit condition] [Move earlier].

maria: good call. Also thinking about a compact rule summary line for long conditions: show first 80 chars + "..." and a tooltip to expand. Tooltip must be keyboard accessible.

julie: interaction for moving between groups: permit keyboard: focus rule, Ctrl+ArrowLeft/Right to move group, Shift+ArrowUp/Down to reorder within group. Document in help.

tonny: small nit on wording: prefer 'shadowed' vs 'unreachable' in UI? 'Shadowed' is shorter but maybe jargon-y. testers preferred 'shadowed by previous rules'.

evan: color blind accessibility: avoid red/green only states. Use icons + text. For match-rate use pattern/bars not pure color.

rachel: preview step-through: add a 'play' that animates sample requests through rules. Also add a 'request filter' so you can pick edge-cases (long prompt, low-prob tokens). design-bot: sample run summary: 20 total requests, 16 matched within group A, 4 fell back to default model.

maria: spec questions: 1) Do we allow grouping by tag? 2) How to represent group priority vs rule priority? 3) Telemetry: capture when users reorder and when they fix shadowed rules.

julie: grouping by tag is nice but need clear UX for mixed tag rules. Maybe 'manual group' with name + auto-suggest tags.

tonny: for display, show both: group badge (G1) and rule numeric (1.3). e.g., G1 - 1.3 means group 1, rule position 3. That helps when copying/pasting rules.

evan: accessibility checklist for the component: focusable drag handles, ARIA key instructions, readable live region updates when preview runs (aria-live=\"polite\"), ensure contrast on badges. I'll write a short a11y QA doc.

rachel: copy nit: change button label 'Step' -> 'Step through sample' and 'Run' -> 'Run sample set'. Testers were confused by single word verbs.

maria: decisions: - implement collapsible groups w/ aggregate match-rate - don't ghost shadowed rules, show banner + actions - improve badge contrast and add pattern bars for match-rate - keyboard moves: Shift/Arrow for reorder, Ctrl/Arrow for cross-group - preview: play + step-through + sample filters - update copy per rachel. julie to update mocks, evan to draft a11y QA, tony to prototype DnD affordances.

julie: I'll update Figma and push a short walkthrough video later today: https://figma.example/routing-groups-v1

evan: starting a11y doc now and will post checklist in this thread when done.

tony: prototyping DnD. question: should cross-group move auto-append to end of target group or prompt? prefer append to end.

maria: append sounds fine for now. we'll monitor via telemetry. closing this thread once mocks are up. thanks all. :rocket:
